<issue>Issue Title: [Bug]: An edge case of JSON string repair for tool callings
Description:
**Describe the bug**
Based on the following code:
https://github.com/agentscope-ai/agentscope/blob/c19b8bc5723ec562fff77d3386f10de3e426f8da/src/agentscope/model/_openai_model.py#L460-L471
Assuming the partial received `input_str` is `'{"points": '`, calling `len(json.dumps(_json_loads_with_repair('{"points": ')))` returns `14`. If final `input_str` turns out to be `'{"points": 1}'`, its length is actually `13`, ***shorter than*** the previously repaired one. As a result, the incomplete data is considered the final tool argument. 🙃
**To Reproduce**
Refer to the description.
**Expected behavior**
More robust repair is expected to correctly handle this edge case.
**Error messages**
Refer to the description.
**Environment (please complete the following information):**
- AgentScope Version: 1.0.17
- Python Version: 3.10
- OS: 22.04
**Additional context**
None
</issue>
